PyJWT: PyJWK accepts empty HMAC keys, bypassing PyJWT's empty-key validation

Aliases: CVE-2026-102266

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N

Affected:

  • pyjwt — fixed in 2.14.0

### Summary A service that verifies HS256 tokens using an empty oct JWK through PyJWK, including a PyJWK obtained from PyJWKSet, can therefore accept attacker-generated tokens as authenticated.
